properties.name: Syresham to Buckingham
properties.description: Head across the fields towards the landscape masterpiece of Stowe to the town that that looks after its river.

properties.name: Alternative route around Stowe
properties.description: Alternative route around Stowe to see more of the architecture and gardens

properties.name: Buckingham to Stony Stratford
properties.description: Trace the path of the long gone Buckingham Canal and pass through villages well off the beaten track.

properties.name: Calverton alternative route
properties.description: This alternative takes a well-used footpath to the Lower Wield of Calverton with several things worth a closer look

properties.name: Stony Stratford to Newport Pagnell
properties.description: Crossing Milton Keynes is a chance to see how tricky questions of development have been tackled and decide for yourself if they got it right.

properties.name: Newport Pagnell to Olney
properties.description: Head from the home of Aston Martin to the town of Amazing Grace

properties.name: Stony Newport alternative route
properties.description: Spend more time on the canals and paths through Milton Keynes

properties.name: Olney to Odell
properties.description: Climb to the heights of Clifton Renes and then across to Bedfordshire.

properties.name: Tyringham detour
properties.description: Get a better view of Tyringham hall, gatehouse and bridge

properties.name: Odell Pavenham
properties.description: Loop round to see more bedfordshire villages and countryside, but not so much river.

properties.name: Odell Pavenham alternative
properties.description: Take a pleasant short cut to Pavenham over the high ground.

properties.name: Pavenham to Bedford
properties.description: Head through a site of special scientific interest and a rather special village.

properties.name: Pavenham to Bedford alternative
properties.description: Alternative shorter route

properties.name: Sherington alternative
properties.description: Alternative shorter route giving you more time to explore Sherington

properties.name: Bedford to Great Barford
properties.description: Head through nature reserves, matchstick woodlands and past a medieval dovecote to reach the popular paddle spot at Great Barford. You could also paddle there.

properties.name: Great Barford to St Neots
properties.description: Head through bucolic fields along the Great Ouse and contrast with the great building works along the Great North Road.

properties.name: St Neots to Godmanchester
properties.description: This is a well marked trail, however, the start can be a little confusing in negotiating the St Neots streets to get to the Way.

properties.name: Godmanchester to Holywell
properties.description: The path out of Godmanchester is a little bit confusing as it heads to and then through the Godmanchester Nature Reserve but becomes clearer as it follows the river along Hemingford Meadow.

properties.name: Holywell to Earith
properties.description: Leaving Holywell, the path heads along a dry ridge which is clearly useful in this floodable area

properties.name: Earith to Ely
properties.description: The route heads around Upper Delphs, Ewell Fen, Holme Fen, Upper Cuts, Middle Cuts and Chear Fen - all names for stretches of reclaimed land.

properties.name: Earith to Ely alternative
properties.description: This alternative route to Ely lets you get a feel for the effort undertaken to drain the Fens. It also is a shorter...

properties.name: Ely to Downham Market
properties.description: At Ely, the Ouse Valley Way combines with the Fen Rivers Way and heads through the fens to Denver Sluice.

properties.name: Downham Market to Kings Lynn
properties.description: From Downham Market the way continues between the two ‘rivers’ through the Wiggenhalls.
